goal: Implement the Native Gravity promo motion graphic in the native-gravity-promo workspace exactly as specified by design/DESIGN.md
constraints: design/DESIGN.md is a read-only copy of promo/motion-graphic/DESIGN.md from the native-gravity repository and is the authoritative spec; never edit it

Items marked [fixed] in DESIGN.md (scenes, copy, color law, landing invariant, caption windows) do not change; other values may move within the tolerances in DESIGN.md section 7, and anything beyond is recorded in DEVIATIONS.md with reason and evidence
Remotion and every other dependency are pinned to exact versions; no ^ or ~ ranges
Rendering is deterministic: no Math.random, Date or CSS animations; fonts are self-hosted woff2 and nothing is fetched over the network during render
No emoji glyphs, no Google/Antigravity/Gemini logos, no model or internal role names, no npm install instructions (DESIGN.md section 2.2)
Do not modify any file in the native-gravity plugin repository

milestones.title: Scaffold the Remotion workspace
milestones.objective: Create the project skeleton from DESIGN.md section 11.3 with tokens, copy, self-hosted fonts and six registered placeholder compositions
acceptance_criteria: package.json pins every dependency to an exact version and defines test, typecheck and render:all scripts
src/tokens.ts holds every color token from DESIGN.md section 5.1 with identical names and hex values, plus the layout constants from section 5.4
src/copy.ts holds every key from DESIGN.md sections 8.1 and 8.2 in en and ko, character-for-character
public/fonts contains Space Grotesk, Inter, JetBrains Mono and Pretendard woff2 files with their OFL license files, loaded with delayRender until ready

npx remotion compositions lists NG-Master-EN, NG-Master-KO (1920x1080, 1470 frames), NG-Short-EN, NG-Short-KO (1920x1080, 450 frames), NG-ReadmeLoop (960x540, 120 frames) and NG-ComponentSheet (1920x1080, 1 frame), all at 30fps
npx tsc --noEmit exits 0 and a still of frame 0 renders for every composition

milestones.title: Motion primitives, timeline and derived world state
milestones.objective: Implement the motion primitives from DESIGN.md section 6 as pure frame functions, the scene tables and story events for master, short and loop, and deriveWorld, with the tests from section 11.5
acceptance_criteria: src/motion exports FLOAT, LAND (normal and fast), REPEL, TEAR, SCAN (normal and mini), STAMP, STALE LIFT, POP, TYPE-ON, LINE REVEAL, POWER OFF/ON and CAPTION with the parameters in DESIGN.md section 6
src/timeline.ts encodes the master scene table from section 7, the short table from 9.1 and the loop from 9.2, plus every story event and caption window those sections give
deriveWorld(events, frame) returns each block's state, last event and frames since that event
npm test runs and passes tests 1 to 6 from DESIGN.md section 11.5, including the [fixed] landing invariant and the section 8.3 reading-speed rule for every caption window
A deliberately broken fixture (a land event without a preceding matching GO) makes the invariant test fail, and the test output shows it

milestones.title: Visual components and component sheet
milestones.objective: Build every object in DESIGN.md section 5.5 and lay them out on NG-ComponentSheet for review
acceptance_criteria: Components exist for MilestoneBlock (all six states), CandidateTab, ClaimChip, LedgerRail, ReviewerCard, ReviewerBeam, VerdictPill (full and mini), ChatBubble, Wordmark, CommandBar, PlanPanel, HudChip, Caption, Background and Dust
out/qa/component-sheet.png shows every block state, both verdict pills, a candidate tab with claim chip, the rail with one lit segment, the reviewer card, the wordmark, and an EN and a KO caption
Colors in the sheet come only from src/tokens.ts and obey the color law in DESIGN.md section 5.2; test 7 from section 11.5 passes
KO text in the sheet renders without missing-glyph boxes, and no text is smaller than 22px

milestones.title: Master scenes S01 to S05
milestones.objective: Assemble the continuous stage and the overlays for master scenes S01 to S05 per DESIGN.md section 7
acceptance_criteria: Blocks, rail and HUD live on one continuous Stage driven by deriveWorld; scene-only elements are Sequence overlays
Stills of NG-Master-EN and NG-Master-KO at frames 60, 210, 380, 520 and 690 match the scene descriptions for S01 to S05
The frame 60, 210 and 690 stills contain zero pixels within 6 of #34A853 per channel
Rendering frame 520 twice gives PNGs with identical SHA-256

milestones.title: Master scenes S06 to S10 and full master renders
milestones.objective: Complete master scenes S06 to S10 and render both full masters
acceptance_criteria: Stills of both masters at frames 820, 1000, 1125, 1230, 1312 and 1469 match the scene descriptions for S06 to S10
out/native-gravity-promo-en-1080p.mp4 and out/native-gravity-promo-ko-1080p.mp4 exist, and ffprobe reports h264, yuv420p, 1920x1080, 30/1 fps and 49.0 seconds within one frame
Every caption on screen matches DESIGN.md section 8 character-for-character in both languages
npm test still passes

milestones.title: Short cut, README loop, posters and QA report
milestones.objective: Produce the remaining deliverables from DESIGN.md section 4 and the QA report from section 13
acceptance_criteria: Both shorts render at 1920x1080, 450 frames, and their stills at frames 30, 120, 230, 330 and 449 match DESIGN.md section 9.1
out/native-gravity-readme-loop.mp4 and .gif exist; the GIF is 960 wide, 15fps, loops forever and is at most 6MB; frames 0 and 119 are attached to show a seamless join
out/poster-en.png and out/poster-ko.png are master frame 1469
scripts/render-all.sh regenerates every deliverable and QA still from a clean out/ directory
QA.md records all ten checks from DESIGN.md section 13 with OBSERVED evidence, and DEVIATIONS.md lists every deviation or states that there are none
non_goals: Audio unless the owner supplies licensed tracks
